svg.title: comparison
svg.text: Corkboard / Kork: four directions (October 2, 2026). Placeholder copy; marks shown at full size and at 32 px.
The proposed Corkboard pack, renamed. Cork field, paper cards, cobalt pushpins, Archivo Black.
Photocopied flyers pasted on a wall: newsprint, hard black type, safety-orange tape and halftone dots.
A dark pegboard where each link is a pin; your pins light up in signal orange. Grotesk type, mono labels.
Library index cards: cream stock, a red top rule, blue ruled lines and a serif wordmark. Quieter and editorial.
